answer: Harberger relic-tax bond: each identity holds one unique relic, priced by a public signal. Each epoch the holder pays 10% tax; anyone may buy it at that price. Priced relics form a nebula map; auditors flag knots. 1,000 fakes at the 200 floor pay 250,000 to forge, 70,000 in bonds, 20,000 tax: 340,000 against a 40,000 pool. Underpricing invites buyouts at 120 net each. Honest agents pay 20 per epoch and keep the full reward.
